'''Kentradee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he set up shop in [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], distributing [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kentradee appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Starship Upgrades vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
